newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mixed on Friday, with some contracts recovering from earlier losses in quiet trade ahead of long weekend, local traders said.
Prices ranged from 20 yen lower to 160 yen higher, with benchmark July 1998 ending up 10 yen at 13,710 yen a tonne. Estimated volume was 29,667 lots.

All months fell at the opening on light selling from local investors, traders said. Book squaring ahead of long weekend and gains during the CBOT overnight session supported some months later, they said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.66-1/2 per bushel at 0805 GMT, against $2.65-1/2 at Thursday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean was traded at $7.70 per bushel at 0805 GMT, down from $7.74-1/2 at Thursday's close.
